title: The 5 Most Transplanted Organs, Ranked (#1 Beats the Rest Combined)

scenes.text: One organ gets transplanted more than every other organ combined.
Number five: the pancreas. About 850 transplants in America in 2024, most alongside a new kidney.
scenes.label: Pancreas · ~850

scenes.text: Number four: the lungs. About 3,400 transplants, more than nine every single day.
scenes.label: Lungs · ~3,400

scenes.text: Number three: the heart. About 4,600 donated hearts, now beating in someone else's chest.
scenes.label: Heart · ~4,600

scenes.text: Number two: the liver. 11,458 transplants in one year, more than thirty every day.
scenes.label: Liver · 11,458

scenes.text: Number one: the kidney. About 28,000 transplants, more than all the others combined. You were born with a spare.
scenes.label: Kidney · ~28,000

description:
The five most transplanted organs in the United States in 2024: pancreas (847, mostly kidney-pancreas), lungs (about 3,400), heart (about 4,600), liver (11,458) and kidney (about 28,000 by OPTN and SRTR counts).
The US passed 48,000 organ transplants in 2024, a record, and kidneys alone outnumbered every other organ combined.
Which number surprised you most?
first_comment: Which organ would you have put at number one, and what should we rank next?
